messages:
marie: Quick design sync: proposing a compact floating mini-controls for the playground while streaming. Shows Stop, a small token counter, and a prompt-lib quick-insert. Figma: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar-v3

ash: Solid. Desktop-first? placement constraints?

marie: Desktop v1, bottom-right above composer. Collapses to single icon on narrow widths.

sam: Dev note: token updates per chunk cause reflow. Debounce to ~250ms and update via transform to avoid layout thrash. Stop is a cancel request.

ash: UX: primary "Stop" should keep partials; "Regenerate" goes under menu to avoid accidents.

ben: Show "+N tokens" when hovering prompt insert so users see cost before inserting. Tooltip on keyboard focus too.

kai: A11y: streaming region should be aria-live="polite"; token meter gets aria-label like "tokens: 120"; toolbar must be in tab order.

a11y-bot: Checklist: keyboard-only flows, NVDA/VoiceOver test, color contrast, non-color cues for meter.

marie: Microcopy: Stop -> tooltip "Stop — keep partial"; Regenerate -> "Regenerate — restart". Shorten if space limited.

sam: Regenerate will replace content by default and show toast "Response replaced — Undo". Simpler than appending.

ben: Visual modes for token meter: collapsed (dot+num), compact (bar+num), expanded (sparkline). Default compact.

kai: Esc should stop stream and return focus to composer. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for animations.

marie: Action items: ash update comps (3 modes); sam prototype debounce + Esc; ben write insert token copy + undo toast; kai run quick a11y pass on comps. Will follow up in design sync. :sparkles:
